name: @pi-vista/cli
description: Offline, read-only observation of pi-vista recorded events, checkpoints, and artifact references

scripts.prepack: npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/core && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/*.test.js"
